SEARCH
Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryCatalyticReformingStoichiometricBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryCatalyticReformingStoichiometricBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryCatalyticReformingStoichiometricBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable material-balance receipt for a catalytic-reforming screening case.

The calculation represents same-carbon-number naphthene dehydrogenation and paraffin dehydrocyclization only. It does not predict reaction kinetics, equilibrium, catalyst performance, operating conditions, heat duty, hydrocracking, isomerization, octane number, or plant yields.

  • Method Details

    • calculate

      public static RefineryCatalyticReformingStoichiometricBalance calculate(int carbonNumber, double naphtheneFeedFlowKmolPerHour, double paraffinFeedFlowKmolPerHour, double naphtheneConversionFraction, double paraffinConversionFraction)
      Calculate a same-carbon-number reforming stoichiometric receipt.

      The two represented reactions are CnH2n -> CnH(2n-6) + 3 H2 and CnH(2n+2) -> CnH(2n-6) + 4 H2.

      Parameters:
      carbonNumber - carbon number shared by the naphthene, paraffin, and aromatic; at least six
      naphtheneFeedFlowKmolPerHour - naphthene feed flow in kmol/h
      paraffinFeedFlowKmolPerHour - paraffin feed flow in kmol/h
      naphtheneConversionFraction - naphthene conversion fraction in [0, 1]
      paraffinConversionFraction - paraffin conversion fraction in [0, 1]
      Returns:
      immutable stoichiometric balance receipt
